subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils v2 07/10] nfsdctl: add missing break in update_listeners()

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the nfsdctl utility where a missing break statement caused a v4 listener to be re-tested as a sockaddr_in6, leading to incorrect behavior. The patch adds breaks at the end of each case arm in the update_listeners function to prevent fallthrough and ensure correct handling of different address families.
